test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six employees (A, B, C, D, E, F) are sitting at a round table with eight chairs. Two of them are not sitting exactly opposite each other. One has no body sitting adjacent to him. E is sitting on the third right to F. B is sitting opposite A. D is sitting opposite E who is second right to A. C is sitting between A and E.

If the boss is sitting adjacent to the vacant chair in each side, then who among them is the boss?
solution: **Six employees: **A, B, C, D, E and F 1) E is sitting on the third right to F. (Assume F is sitting in South direction and facing inside the table) 2) D is sitting opposite E who is second right to A.
